info.name: AutoStore Task Interface (XML + JSON)
info.description: Every Task Interface call. Optional parameters are commented out: XML <!-- -->, JSON // with a leading comma. The JSON layout mirrors the XML and is not confirmed against AutoStore documentation. Generated by postman/build_collection.py.

exec: // req_time = now in UTC, without milliseconds (the SDK format)

request.description: Open a port for a category; AutoStore starts preparing bins.

body.raw:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<methodcall>
  <name>openport</name>
  <params>
    <port_id>{{port_id}}</port_id>
    <!-- <req_time>{{req_time}}</req_time> -->
    <!-- <port_mode></port_mode>  e.g. SEQUENCE -->
    <select>
      <category>{{category}}</category> <!-- repeat for more categories -->
      <!-- <content></content>  select by content code instead -->
    </select>
  </params>
</methodcall>

request.description: Request the next bin at the port. Use at most ONE selector (else 1023).

body.raw:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<methodcall>
  <name>openbin</name>
  <params>
    <port_id>{{port_id}}</port_id>
    <!-- <bin_id>{{bin_id}}</bin_id>  ad-hoc bin -->
    <!-- <task_id>{{task_id}}</task_id> -->
    <!-- <taskgroup_id>{{taskgroup_id}}</taskgroup_id>  resume a suspended group -->
    <!-- <shipment>{{shipment}}</shipment> -->
  </params>
</methodcall>

request.description: Close the bin after the pick.

body.raw:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<methodcall>
  <name>closebin</name>
  <params>
    <port_id>{{port_id}}</port_id>
    <bin_id>{{bin_id}}</bin_id>
    <!-- <task_id>{{task_id}}</task_id>  recommended: without it bin mode can loop -->
    <!-- <content></content> -->
    <!-- <taskcomplete>true</taskcomplete> -->
  </params>
</methodcall>

request.description: End the port session.

body.raw:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<methodcall>
  <name>closeport</name>
  <params>
    <port_id>{{port_id}}</port_id>
    <!-- <suspend_taskgroup>1</suspend_taskgroup>  1 = lock the group for a later resume -->
  </params>
</methodcall>

request.description: Register a bin inserted at the port.

body.raw:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<methodcall>
  <name>insertbin</name>
  <params>
    <port_id>{{port_id}}</port_id>
    <bin_id>{{bin_id}}</bin_id>
    <!-- <content></content> -->
    <!-- <bin_type></bin_type>  required the first time a bin is inserted -->
  </params>
</methodcall>

request.description: Register the open bin removed from the port.
Create a task group and its tasks (copy <task> for more).

body.raw:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<methodcall>
  <name>create_taskgroup</name>
  <params>
    <taskgroup_id>{{taskgroup_id}}</taskgroup_id>
    <!-- <shipment>{{shipment}}</shipment> -->
    <category>{{category}}</category>
    <req_time>{{req_time}}</req_time> <!-- SDK faults 1035 without it -->
    <!-- <priority>20</priority> -->
    <!-- <suspended>0</suspended> -->
    <tasks>
      <task>
        <task_id>{{task_id}}</task_id>
        <bin_id>{{bin_id}}</bin_id>
        <!-- <item>1</item> -->
        <!-- <order></order> -->
        <!-- <estpicktime>20</estpicktime>  seconds -->
      </task>
    </tasks>
  </params>
</methodcall>

request.description: Update group-level properties only (not its tasks).
Add one task to an existing group.
Cancel a single task (not while it is selected).
Cancel a whole task group.
Replace the port's task-group sequence (SEQUENCE mode).

body.raw:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<methodcall>
  <name>setportsequence</name>
  <params>
    <port_id>{{port_id}}</port_id>
    <taskgroups>
      <taskgroup_id>{{taskgroup_id}}</taskgroup_id> <!-- repeat for each group -->
    </taskgroups>
  </params>
</methodcall>

request.description: Append task groups to the port sequence.

body.raw:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<methodcall>
  <name>appendportsequence</name>
  <params>
    <port_id>{{port_id}}</port_id>
    <taskgroups>
      <taskgroup_id>{{taskgroup_id}}</taskgroup_id> <!-- repeat for each group -->
    </taskgroups>
  </params>
</methodcall>

request.description: Read the port's task-group sequence.
Light a pick: source + optional target compartment.
Cancel a pick-to-light.
Enable a MultiPort (ports must be empty).
Disable a MultiPort.
Send all bins at a port back to the grid.
Send one bin back to the grid.
Set bin(s) to FORECAST. One bin_id OR a min/max range.

body.raw:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<methodcall>
  <name>forecastbin</name>
  <params>
    <bin_id>{{bin_id}}</bin_id> <!-- or use the range below instead -->
    <!-- <min_bin_id></min_bin_id> -->
    <!-- <max_bin_id></max_bin_id> -->
  </params>
</methodcall>

request.description: Take bin(s) out of FORECAST. One bin_id OR a range.

body.raw:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<methodcall>
  <name>cancelforecastbin</name>
  <params>
    <bin_id>{{bin_id}}</bin_id> <!-- or use the range below instead -->
    <!-- <min_bin_id></min_bin_id> -->
    <!-- <max_bin_id></max_bin_id> -->
  </params>
</methodcall>
